groups.defect: The missing cache re-check after acquiring the write lock causes redundant serialized cold-start manifest loads, and holding the exclusive lock across file I/O serializes every Dev-mode request.
groups.rationale: All three report the same missing second cache check at the write-lock acquisition. s_25eea308 and s_7e94bcff also report Dev-mode serialization across disk I/O, so the merged comment must preserve both defects.
